missing.concept_he: יאוש / אין שום יאוש בעולם כלל
missing.concept_en: despair (yiush) and its prohibition — 'there is no despair in the world at all'
missing.refs: LM II:78; also LM II:48
missing.why: Zero hits for יאוש/מתיאש/despair anywhere in the 3,588-concept vocab. This is arguably the most famous single line in Likutey Moharan and the causal hinge of the whole hitchazkut cluster (despair as the harms-edge, its negation as the eitza). Its absence is a major hole: atzvut (c:atzvut) and marah shechorah (c:marah-shechorah-black) exist, but their terminal state yiush does not.

missing.concept_en: hitchazkut — self-strengthening, refusing to fall from one's own descents; includes the 'great stubbornness' (עקשנות גדול) required in avodah
missing.refs: LM II:48 (העיקר... צריך להתחזק; עקשנות גדול בעבודת ה'); LM II:78; LM I:282 as its method
missing.why: Zero hits for התחזקות/חזוק עצמו/עקשנות. The only chizzuk nodes are c:chizzuk-ha-lev (a different concept: heart containing intellect) and strengthening-the-dream-angel nodes (LM I:54 context). Hitchazkut is named in this audit's own domain list and is the organizing concept of LM II:48/II:78 — it must be a node so despair->harms and hitchazkut->builds edges have an anchor.

missing.concept_en: temimut u-peshitut — wholehearted simplicity in serving God, casting away sophistication
missing.refs: LM II:19 (העיקר הוא תמימות ופשיטות); LM II:78 (better to be a 'prostak'); LM II:5
missing.why: Zero hits for תמימות or פשיטות as an avodah trait. Existing 'simple' nodes are all other senses: achdut pashut (c:achdut-pashut), sekhel pashut (c:binah-2), or ha-pashut (c:kamitz-setim), ben tam (c:gen-3), tzaddik ha-pashut (c:tzaddik-ha-pashut). The devotional-quality concept of LM II:19 is absent.

missing.concept_en: emunah peshutah — simple faith, relying on faith alone and discarding chakirot/philosophy
missing.refs: LM II:19; LM I:62 context (chakirot vs emunah); cf. c:ikkar-hasagat-ha gloss which already invokes 'simple faith'
missing.why: 37 emunah nodes exist (emunah shelemah, emunat chakhamim, fallen faith, etc.) but none for simple faith as opposed to speculative inquiry — a distinct, load-bearing concept in LM II:19 and throughout Part II. Note node c:ikkar-hasagat-ha's gloss even says 'achieved through simple faith', so edges already want this target.

missing.concept_he: מצוה גדולה להיות בשמחה תמיד / להפך יגון ואנחה לשמחה
missing.concept_en: the great mitzvah to be in joy always; transforming sorrow (yagon va'anachah) into joy; including milei di-shtuta (jesting/silliness) as a means to joy
missing.refs: LM II:24
missing.why: Zero hits for יגון, 'בשמחה תמיד', or מילי דשטותא. The registry has generic simchah (c:simchah) and many I:54/I:24-derived joy nodes, but LM II:24 — the flagship counsel that constant joy is a mitzvah, that sicknesses stem from broken joy, and that sorrow must be chased down and turned into joy — has no node. Without it the central simchah eitza-edge of Part II has nowhere to land.

missing.concept_en: hoda'ah — thanksgiving/acknowledgment to God as a practice, the delight of the World to Come ('yemei hoda'ah')
missing.refs: LM II:2 (עיקר שעשוע עולם הבא הוא הודאה); cf. chatzot node c:six-hours-night whose gloss mentions 'lament and thanksgiving'
missing.why: Zero hits for הודאה/הודיה as a standalone concept. Only two Azamra clause-nodes (c:ability-pray-sing, c:ability-sing-thank) mention lehodot in passing. LM II:2 makes hoda'ah itself the substance of olam haba and pairs it with halakhah — a core practice concept missing entirely.

fragmented.note: Four ids for the one practice of secluded conversation with God (LM II:25, I:52, II:100, I:156 contexts): התבודדות (c:room-field — note the id also mismatches its content), מתבודד ומפרש שיחתו בינו לבין קונו, שצריך כל אחד לדבר בינו לבין קונו, מה שמדברים בינו לבין קונו. The last three are the same definitional phrase and should merge into the main hitbodedut node.
Three nodes for the single LM I:6 concept of the second repentance done over one's first repentance (kevod olam haba). Same teaching, same referent.

The bare concept מחלקת lives at c:contradictory-ideas (slug mismatch); c:machaloket is actually the EFFECT 'nullifying machloket'; c:machloket's Hebrew is אחדות שנתגלה בישראל — unity, the opposite of its id (polarity-inversion hazard for any edge attached to it). Legitimate distinct nodes (machloket le-shem shamayim, Shammai/Hillel, mei merivah) exist alongside; the generic node needs consolidation. Refs: LM I:64 (machloket as briat ha-olam), I:46.

fragmented.note: Same concept (LM I:4: vidui devarim before a talmid chacham) under two transliteration-variant ids plus a third phrasal node יספר לפני התלמיד חכם הינו ודוי דברים.

חדושי תורה and חדושין דאוריתא are Hebrew/Aramaic forms of the same concept (LM I:20, I:60 context) and should be one node with the Aramaic as a form.

לשון הקדש (c:hebrew) vs שלמות לשון הקדש (c:shlemut, LM I:19) — the second may be a defensible distinct bechina (perfection of the holy tongue), but the slugs are both wrong for their content and the pair needs an explicit relation or a merge. Note also lashon hara's canonical node is c:human — a severe id/content mismatch worth fixing while consolidating this cluster.

fragmented.node_ids: c:shmirat-ha-brit, c:sexual-purity, c:shmirat-ha-brit-2, c:ni'uf, c:ni'uf-adultery, c:guarding-against-lust, c:nocturnal-emission
fragmented.note: Seven ids for one concept. c:shmirat-ha-brit (שמירת הברית בשתי בחינות) and c:sexual-purity (על־ידי שמירת הברית בשני הבחינות הנ"ל) are the SAME phrase from LM I:11 (the two aspects: zivug from Shabbat to Shabbat, etc.). c:ni'uf-adultery (שמירה מנאוף), c:guarding-against-lust (שמירה מתאוה נאוף) and c:nocturnal-emission (שמירה מתאות נאוף) are one 'guarding from the lust' concept — and c:nocturnal-emission's slug does not match its Hebrew at all.

c:pegam-ha-brit and c:pgam-ha-brit are two ids differing only in slug vowel; worse, c:pgam-ha-brit's Hebrew is actually נמצא רבב על בגדיו, duplicating c:stain-grease-spot (הכתם והרבב שנמצא על בגדו) and c:stain-one's-clothing (פגם הבגדים) — the talmid-chacham-with-a-stain motif (cf. LM I:29 citing Shabbat 114a) is spread across four nodes.

c:brit-organ-procreation (תקון הברית), c:elul-kavanot (תקון לפגם הברית) and c:sexual-purity-2 (תקון הכללי, שהוא תקון הברית) all denote the covenant's rectification; the tikkun-haklali=tikkun-habrit equation node should merge into or equate with the base, and both slugs (brit-organ-procreation, elul-kavanot) mislabel their content.

The lust itself is split between תאות ממון (tmp:0014) and תאות עשירות (tmp:1768) — same vice (LM I:23, I:68). Its removal is split three ways: שבירת (tmp:0013), נתתקן (tmp:0016), נתבטל חמדת הממון (tmp:2094 — LM I:23 via mezuzah). tmp:0015 is an explicit rectification-statement fragment, not a concept. tmp:1878 (משקע בתאות ממון) and tmp:2223 (ממון של המשקעים בממון) both encode the sunk-in-money state (anpin chashukhin, LM I:23).

missing.refs: LM I:64:2 — the two kinds of apikorsut (from shevirat ha-kelim, answerable; from the chalal ha-panui, unanswerable); LM II:52
missing.why: The concept exists only inside counsel-sentence fragments: c:apikorsut = יודע להשיב על אפיקורסות שבלבו (a counsel, not the force) and c:fittingness-there-unanswerable = שיהיו עליו יתברך קשיות (a fragment). There is no clean node for אפיקורסות itself, nor for LM I:64's key distinction of קשיות שאי אפשר ליישב originating in the chalal ha-panui — even though c:chalal-ha-panui exists and needs that edge target. כפירה appears only as כפירה בעבודה זרה (which is a POSITIVE concept — denying idolatry).

fragmented.theme: Sitra achra core — IDs scrambled across the cluster
fragmented.node_ids: c:dispute, c:sitra-achra, c:azut-ha-guf, c:embodied-avimelekh, c:sitra-demota, c:sitra-de-mota
fragmented.note: The base term סטרא אחרא lives under c:dispute; meanwhile c:sitra-achra actually holds עזות הגוף, and c:azut-ha-guf holds עזות דסטרא אחרא — the two contents are swapped relative to their slugs (LM I:22 material). סטרא דמסאבא sits under c:embodied-avimelekh. And c:sitra-demota (סטרא דמותא) vs c:sitra-de-mota (verse fragment 'זה תנצל מבחינת חמץ, שהיא סטרא דמותא') are hyphen-twin ids for one concept (LM I:5's chametz/sitra-de-mota). Any edge audit touching the SA cluster is unreliable until these are re-keyed and merged.

fragmented.theme: Kelipot — base concept split across five nodes
fragmented.node_ids: c:kelipot-husks-shells, c:klipah, c:husks-impurity, c:kelipot, c:other-side-husks, c:bechinat-libi-secharchar
fragmented.note: c:kelipot-husks-shells (קלפות) is the real base; c:klipah is a verse fragment (שעמד בנסיון ושבר הקלפה שקדמה לפרי); c:husks-impurity is the event יתבטלו הקלפות; c:kelipot is שלש קלפות הנ"ל (the three impure kelipot — defensible as separate, but slug claims the generic term); c:other-side-husks is another fragment. Also c:bechinat-libi-secharchar actually holds קלפת נגה (kelipat nogah) — a major standalone concept hidden under an unrelated slug.

Four nodes say the same thing: c:ni'uf (נצול מנאוף וזוכה לשמירת הברית), c:ni'uf-adultery (שמירה מנאוף), c:guarding-against-lust (שמירה מתאוה נאוף), c:nocturnal-emission (שמירה מתאות נאוף). Meanwhile the base concept נאוף itself sits under the mismatched slug c:covering-arayot. Should be one 'shemirah from niuf' node (or edges into c:desire-base with via=absence), and the base re-keyed. Cf. LM I:36.

c:adulterous-fantasies (מועלת מאד להנצל מהרהורי נאוף) and c:charity-2 (מצלת מהרהורים של נאוף) are the same effect-node twice, both actually counsel-sentence fragments. The base הרהורים של נאוף hides under c:avi-avot-hatum'ah — a slug that means something else entirely (avi avot ha-tumah). c:kaneh (הרהורים רעים) likely also belongs to this cluster.

fragmented.theme: Taavat mamon — base, state, synonym, and two 'rectified' nodes
fragmented.node_ids: c:lust-money, c:lust-money-2, c:money-hoarding-sitra, c:itzavon, c:desire-money-rectified, c:menstrual-blood-money, c:shevirat-ta'avat-mamon
fragmented.note: c:lust-money (תאות ממון) is the base; c:lust-money-2 (משקע בתאות ממון) is a state-duplicate; c:money-hoarding-sitra (תאות עשירות) is the same lust under LM I:23's other name; c:itzavon holds a fragment about המשקעים בממון. And there are two rectification nodes: c:desire-money-rectified (נתתקן תאות ממון) and c:menstrual-blood-money (נתתקן דם נדה, תאות ממון) — the latter fusing LM I:29's dam-niddah↔mamon identification into a compound. Refs: LM I:23, I:68, I:29.

fragmented.node_ids: c:ka'as, c:kevishat-ka'as, c:yad-va-shem, c:lm-8, c:tikkun-ha-ka, c:nitbatel-ha-ka, c:sweetening-anger-compassion, c:breaking
fragmented.note: Base כעס exists, but subduing it appears three times (c:kevishat-ka'as כבישת כעס, c:yad-va-shem שיכבש כעסו, c:lm-8 שישמר מכעס), rectification twice (c:tikkun-ha-ka, c:nitbatel-ha-ka), and the LM I:18 anger-sweetened-by-rachmanut move twice (c:sweetening-anger-compassion ימתיק הכעס ברחמנות vs c:breaking כפי הפרת הכעס ברחמנות — same teaching, same proof-text family; cf. also LM I:68 on kaas damaging wealth).

fragmented.theme: Azut de-kedushah — four slug variants of one concept
fragmented.node_ids: c:azut-di-kedushah, c:azut-d'kedushah, c:azut-di-kedushah-4, c:azut-di-kedushah-5, c:more-azut-di, c:kol-oz
fragmented.note: עזות דקדשה appears under four ids differing only in transliteration/suffix: c:azut-di-kedushah (עזות דקדשה), c:azut-d'kedushah (fragment: מתגברין בעזות גדול כנגדם), c:azut-di-kedushah-4 (עזות דקדשה שיש בו), c:azut-di-kedushah-5 (מקבל עזות דקדשה מהשם יתברך), plus c:more-azut-di (עזות יותר). One concept (LM I:22, I:147, I:30:8) fragmented into micro-variants; its dark counterpart עזות דסטרא אחרא / עזות הגוף is in the swapped-id mess noted above.

c:spirit-folly (שמגרש במהירות הרוח שטות מקרבו) and c:spirit-folly-3 (לגרש מקרבו הרוח שטות) are the same expulsion-event twice; c:predicated (רוח שטות נתבטל) is a third event-shadow of the base c:ruach-shetut-per. Sotah 3a's ruach shetut as expounded in LM — one base node plus edges suffices.

fragmented.node_ids: c:koach-ha-medammeh, c:koach-ha-medameh, c:koach-ha-medammeh-2, c:eye-guarded-power, c:tikkun, c:paired-phrase
fragmented.note: c:koach-ha-medammeh (כח המדמה) and c:koach-ha-medameh (המדמה) differ by one letter in the slug and are the same faculty (LM I:25, II:8 — the imagination as the seat of false belief). Plus separate guarded-heart / guarded-eye event nodes (c:koach-ha-medammeh-2, c:eye-guarded-power) and two tikkun nodes (c:tikkun תקון המדמה, c:paired-phrase תקון המדמה והאמונה).

fragmented.theme: Machloket — base under wrong slug plus event-shadows
fragmented.node_ids: c:contradictory-ideas, c:machaloket, c:contentiousness-winning, c:notzot-yinatzu, c:meraglim-regel-foot, c:responsa
fragmented.note: The base concept מחלקת sits under c:contradictory-ideas, while c:machaloket holds only the event מבטל המחלקת. c:contentiousness-winning (לבטל מדת הנצחון והמחלקת ולרדף אחר השלום) overlaps it, c:notzot-yinatzu (מחלקת ובזיונות) and c:meraglim-regel-foot (בעלי לשון הרע ומחלקת) are compound fragments, c:responsa a sentence fragment. Also note מדת הנצחון (the drive to win, a distinct LM negative trait) exists only inside the compound.

fragmented.theme: Ra ayin (evil eye) — base under odd slug, duplicate rescue nodes
fragmented.note: Base רע עין is under c:between-your-eyes; c:saved-evil-eye (האדם נצול מרע עין הזה) and c:ra-ayin (נצול הצדיק מרע עין של הרשע) are two 'saved-from' event nodes — and the slug c:ra-ayin, which should hold the base, holds a rescue-event instead. LM I:54 (ra ayin and shikhchah).

c:ekev (מכניע עקב דסטרא אחרא) and c:nikhna-bechinat-ekev (נכנע בחינת עקב דסטרא אחרא) are the active and passive voicing of one event on one concept (the 'heel' of the SA). Merge to one node; the underlying עקב דסטרא אחרא itself has no base node either.

fragmented.theme: Machshavot zarot — base vs rescue vs compound
fragmented.note: c:machshavot-zarot (מחשבות זרות שבתפלה, LM I:72) vs c:machshavot-zarot-2 (נצול ממחשבות זרות — a rescue event) vs c:mental-faculties (compound fragment לפנות את המחין מחכמות חיצוניות וממחשבות זרות). The plain concept מחשבות זרות outside prayer has no base node; the -2 suffix signals an unmerged near-duplicate.

c:ga'avah (גאוה) is the base; c:ga'avah-2 (נתבטל הגאוה) and c:ga'avah-3 (הפך הגאוה) are its nullification/inversion events carrying numbered-suffix ids — the classic sign of an unmerged cluster; c:gerim-9 (תקון הגאוה וההתפארות שמביאין הגרים, LM I:14 material) is a counsel-sentence fragment on the same trait.
